description: Source code for REST API resource classes handling application and attempt data in Apache Spark's history server, including endpoints for jobs, executors, stages, RDDs, environment info, logs, and application attempts.

classes.name: AbstractApplicationResource
classes.description: Base class providing REST API endpoints for Spark application data, including jobs, executors, stages, RDDs, environment info, logs, and application attempts.

classes.name: OneApplicationResource
classes.description: Derived class providing specific endpoint to get application info.

classes.name: OneApplicationAttemptResource
classes.description: Derived class providing endpoint to get specific application attempt info.

methods.name: jobsList
methods.description: Returns list of jobs filtered by status.

methods.name: oneJob
methods.description: Returns data for a specific job by ID.

methods.name: threadDump
methods.description: Returns thread dump for a specific executor.

methods.name: getTaskThreadDump
methods.description: Returns thread dump for a specific task on an executor.

methods.name: allExecutorList
methods.description: Returns list of all executors, including inactive.

methods.name: rddList
methods.description: Returns list of RDD storage info.

methods.name: rddData
methods.description: Returns data for a specific RDD by ID.

methods.name: environmentInfo
methods.description: Returns environment information for the application.

methods.name: getEventLogs
methods.description: Streams event logs as a ZIP file.

methods.name: applicationAttempt
methods.description: Returns the class for application attempt resource if attemptId is null.

methods.name: getApp
methods.description: Returns application info for the current app.

methods.name: getAttempt
methods.description: Returns info for a specific application attempt.
